newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex details Jan-Oct refining, natgas income.
newsitem.headline: Pemex details Jan-Oct refining, natgas income.

text.p: Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Monday its refining unit generated 69.96 billion pesos in the first 10 months of the year, selling 1.48 million barrels per day (bpd) of petroleum byproducts in the domestic market.
Income from petroleum byproducts grew by 22.18 billion pesos from January to October compared to the same period in 1995, the state-owned oil and gas monopoly said in a statement.
Pemex's refining unit produced an average 475,100 barrels of unleaded and leaded gasoline per day from January to October, the company said, while diesel production reached 241,000 bpd.
Domestic production of jet fuel averaged 45,200 bpd from January to October, while fuel oil production reached 417,900 bpd, Pemex said.

National sales of kerosenes, industrial gas oil, asphalt, coke, grease and lubricants reached 36,800 bpd in the first 10 months of the year. Pemex's liquid gas production reached 260,600 bpd, the company said.
